d: Producer Namit Malhotra and director Nitesh Tiwari set out to take Indian storytelling global with Ramayana: The Rise of Legend, aiming to make a historic mark in Western cinema. Following its worldwide theatrical release on November 5, international publications and leading Hollywood critics have officially weighed in on this ₹4,000-crore epic. From The Guardian awarding the film an impressive 4 out of 5 stars and comparing its scope to Shakespeare, Christopher Nolan, and Peter Jackson’s The Lord of the Rings, to The New York Times analyzing its dutiful dialogues and magnificent aerial…
